content.text:
This is an overhead photo of one plate of food from a cafeteria.
List every visible food on the plate, at most 20 items. For each item, estimate its weight in grams and its food energy in kilocalories (kcal).
Reply with only one JSON object in exactly this shape, and nothing else:
{"items": [{"name": "<food name>", "grams": <number>, "kcal": <number>}]}
Use an empty list if no food is visible.

{"items": [{"name": "sliced beef steak", "grams": 110, "kcal": 240}, {"name": "cauliflower florets", "grams": 150, "kcal": 38}, {"name": "roasted potato cubes", "grams": 120, "kcal": 180}, {"name": "stuffing or mashed mixture", "grams": 80, "kcal": 140}, {"name": "sliced chicken breast", "grams": 60, "kcal": 70}, {"name": "bran muffin or cornbread patty", "grams": 60, "kcal": 210}, {"name": "green vegetable (cabbage or broccoli bits)", "grams": 30, "kcal": 10}]}
